Looks up the trait candidates in scope for a HIR id by querying the owner’s trait map and indexing by local id. It calls `in_scope_traits_map`.
Returns the resolved named bound variable associated with a HIR id, if present, by consulting the owner’s named-variable map. It calls `named_variable_map`.

Checks whether a definition corresponds to impl-trait-in-trait by testing for RPITIT metadata. It calls `opt_rpitit_info`.
Returns the locally resolved children of a module, or an empty slice if none were recorded. It calls `resolutions`.

Registers query providers backed by resolver and untracked context data, including trait-import data, glob imports, extern crate mappings, crate attributes, panic-handler presence, and source spans. It then uses `simple_ident` to name the parameter in the labels and finally emits the `LifetimeMismatch` diagnostic via `dcx().emit_err`.

Builds an `AddLifetimeParamsSuggestion` from the given type and region information and attaches it to an existing diagnostic. It calls `add_to_diagnostic` on the constructed suggestion to add the lifetime-parameter help.

Finds the function-signature input type that corresponds to the target bound region for a suitable region error. It calls `find_component_for_bound_region` while scanning `fn_sig.decl.inputs`, and returns the matched `hir::Ty` together with the enclosing `hir::FnSig`.

Searches a single HIR type for the sub-type associated with the requested bound region by creating a `FindNestedTypeVisitor`. It calls `FindNestedTypeVisitor::visit_ty` on the argument type and returns the visitor's recorded match, if any.
Provides the HIR map used by `FindNestedTypeVisitor` during traversal. It returns `self.tcx.hir()` and does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Walks HIR types to locate the first type node whose bound lifetime matches the target bound region, while tracking De Bruijn depth across binders. For `BareFn` it calls `intravisit::walk_ty`; for trait objects it calls `visit_poly_trait_ref`; for path types it inspects nested type structure and then uses `TyPathVisitor` to check only immediate lifetime arguments; when a matching `Ref` or path lifetime is found, it records the current `hir::Ty` as the result.
Provides the HIR map used by `TyPathVisitor` during traversal. It returns `self.tcx.hir()` and does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Checks whether an immediate lifetime argument on a path resolves to the target named bound region at the current De Bruijn depth. It sets `found_it` when the resolved early-bound or late-bound lifetime matches, and does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Intentionally ignores nested type nodes inside a path so only the path's immediate lifetime arguments are considered by `TyPathVisitor`. It does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Public entry point that constructs a `NiceRegionError` from the given `RegionResolutionError`, then attempts to report it and returns whether reporting succeeded. It explicitly calls `NiceRegionError::new` and then `NiceRegionError::try_report`.
Creates a `NiceRegionError` backed by an original `RegionResolutionError`, storing the type error context and leaving the explicit region triple unset. It does not call other methods in this file.

Creates a `NiceRegionError` from an explicit `(Span, sub-region, super-region)` triple instead of a `RegionResolutionError`, storing the context and leaving the error field unset. It does not call other methods in this file.
Returns the underlying `TyCtxt` from the stored `TypeErrCtxt` for use by helper routines and submodules. It does not call other methods in this file.

Attempts the subset of specialized diagnostics used for NLL/MIR borrow-checker errors, stopping at the first successful diagnostic builder. It explicitly calls `try_report_named_anon_conflict`, `try_report_placeholder_conflict`, and `try_report_placeholder_relation`.

Extracts a common `(Span, sub-region, super-region)` view of the error by decoding supported `RegionResolutionError` variants or returning the explicitly stored region triple. It does not call other methods in this file.

Checks whether the stored region error is the specific impl-vs-trait lifetime mismatch shape: a `RegionResolutionError::SubSupConflict` from `CompareImplItemObligation` with matching `Subtype` traces over the same `ValuePairs::PolySigs`. Creates a fresh `HighlightBuilder`, initializes empty region-highlighting state, and traverses the given type by calling `visit_ty` so unnamed regions can be numbered for diagnostic display.
Visits each region in a type traversal and assigns display numbers to up to three anonymous regions by recording them in the highlight state; named regions are left unchanged.
Returns the HIR map from `tcx` so `TypeParamSpanVisitor` can perform nested HIR traversal.

Collects spans of plain type parameters, `Self`, and `Self` aliases used in a trait method type while intentionally skipping borrow suggestions for `&T` and `&Self`. For reference types it traverses only the inner type by calling `hir::intravisit::walk_ty`; for all other cases it continues recursive traversal by calling `hir::intravisit::walk_ty` after any matching span is recorded.
